definitions.gloss: to drink together; to exchange cups of sake
definitions.explanation: To share drinks with someone, each person pouring for the other. Implies a warm, convivial atmosphere of mutual drinking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{酌|く}み{交|か}わした。
examples.english: I shared drinks with a friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旧友|きゅうゆう}→旧友：17475_kyuuyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{杯|さかずき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{酌|く}み{交|か}わした。
examples.english: After a long time, I exchanged cups of sake with an old friend.

examples.japanese: {夜遅|よるおそ}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{酌|く}み{交|か}わし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{咲|さ}かせた→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: We shared drinks late into the night, reminiscing about the old days.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat literary or elegant expression for drinking together. Implies mutual pouring and shared conversation. More refined than simply ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{酌|く}み{交|か}わす (to share sake)
- {杯|さかずき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{酌|く}み{交|か}わす (to exchange cups)
- ⟦{語|かた}り{合|あ}い→語り合う：03045_katariau⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{酌|く}み{交|か}わす (to drink while talking together)

COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb ({酌|く}み{交|か}わす → {酌|く}み{交|か}わさない → {酌|く}み{交|か}わして). The ⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧ component indicates mutual action, like ⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧.
